title: TheBold
lede: TheBold puts investor access behind an AI readiness interview and a tracked record of execution, then lets founders who qualify book time directly on matching investors' calendars.

points: Shows which metrics and execution signals particular investors look for, and which of them a founder is closest to meeting.
Regular AI check-ins turn a chosen goal into commitments for each cycle and log what was done, learned and changed.
Completed commitments and moving metrics build a verified history that is checked against each investor's criteria.
Qualifying unlocks an AI rehearsal of that investor's first call, built from their thesis and usual questions; passing it opens booking.
Investors can also browse qualified founders and invite them. A launch Fast Track runs from 17 to 27 November.

sections.text: Early-stage founders who keep hearing 'come back in a few months' and want a concrete list of what to change, plus a route back to the same investor once they have.
